explication: Agent Canvas is a self-hosted developer control center for coding agents and automations. A developer selects a backend, starts a conversation, sends a coding task, and receives streamed agent events and results in the chat UI. The frontend also manages agent/LLM profiles, repositories, tools, and persistent conversation state. Automations provide a parallel scheduled or webhook-triggered workflow through external services. Sampled source confirms backend persistence, query error handling, profile activation, subscription access, and desktop startup; some service wiring is inferred from documented architecture.
